title: Might lose my MallWorld membership, but…
content: When I found this thread, it blew my mind, and I think many people who arrive here share this sentiment, that I/we have a special reverence for this place. So, understand, no shade is meant by my posting this, it’s more out of a sense of frustration. Lately this thread has lost me because it feels like it’s just become two things: 1. Non-stop, repeat AI generated images of the places historically mentioned throughout the archives of the thread, as if someone scraped it, fed it as a series of prompts, generated a series of images, and post them at a modulated cadence for post karma. 2. Folks who genuinely visit places that they want to share here, but ask “has anyone been here!?” (with an AI image), as if they haven’t read through the threads. To those just genuinely sharing, you are not the problem, and apologies for my saltiness around AI images. BUT, chances are, many of us ARE familiar with the landscapes and places you’ve seen and have posted about it in the past. It could be valuable and exciting to go back and read through and connect with people on those threads. For anyone else choosing to troll this thread with its own history in AI image form, just …why? I could be all wrong here, and mods, do what you must, but please know it comes from a place of love. It’s just been bugging the crap out of me not to call it out.
